Brand profiles that persist a team's colors, typography and preferences so every generated component stays on-brand

projects.name: SMS Protocol
projects.description: SMS-based cryptocurrency transactions for feature phones — send and receive crypto over a plain text message, with private keys secured by Multi-Party Computation for financial inclusion in low-connectivity regions.
features: Send/receive crypto by texting a formatted SMS (e.g. 'SEND 0.5 ETH TO 0x...') — no smartphone or internet required
Twilio SMS gateway parses inbound messages, validates the request, and extracts amount and recipient
Private keys split via Multi-Party Computation (MPC) so no single party ever holds the full key
Transactions signed and submitted on-chain to Ethereum and Avalanche via Web3.js / ethers.js
Aimed at financial inclusion for feature-phone users in rural, low-connectivity areas

projects.name: Redeem
projects.description: A production-ready coupon management and validation REST API in Go, built for e-commerce platforms that need flexible, high-performance discount logic.
features: Multiple coupon types — one-time, multi-use, and time-based — with percentage and fixed-amount discounts
Context-aware validation that analyzes the cart and supports product- and category-level targeting
In-memory LRU cache with TTL for sub-millisecond coupon lookups
Concurrency-safe by design using mutex locking and atomic operations
Full OpenAPI 3.0 spec with a browsable Swagger UI
Containerized with Docker Compose for a one-command local stack (API + MongoDB)

projects.name: Durable Execution Engine
projects.description: A fault-tolerant workflow engine for Go that makes ordinary functions automatically resumable and crash-resistant — inspired by Temporal, Cadence, DBOS and Azure Durable Functions.
features: Turns normal Go code into durable workflows — each step executes once and is memoized so a crash resumes exactly where it left off
Sequence tracking that correctly handles loops and repeated steps across replays
Thread-safe parallel step execution within a workflow
SQLite-backed persistence of workflow state with a small, embeddable API (NewEngine / Execute / Step)

projects.name: Fan-Out Engine
projects.description: A high-throughput distributed data-processing engine in Java that streams very large files (100GB+) and fans records out to multiple sink systems in parallel — each with its own transform, rate limit, and fault handling.
features: Streams files line-by-line via BufferedReader — processes 100GB+ inputs on a 512MB heap, never loading the whole file
Pluggable transformers per sink: JSON, Protobuf, XML, and Avro
Per-sink token-bucket rate limiting that allows bursts while holding an average rate
Fault tolerance with up to 3 retries, exponential backoff, and a dead-letter queue for failed records
Backpressure via a bounded ArrayBlockingQueue so a slow sink can't exhaust memory
Graceful degradation — one sink failing doesn't stall the others

Log-analysis agent that extracts structured signals from noisy pipeline logs
Root-cause agent that applies causal reasoning to determine why a failure occurred
Pipeline of specialized agents on a shared base-agent abstraction, with synthetic data generation for realistic testing
Designed to extend into automated fix generation and remediation
